test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following processes is carried out on connecting rods to locate the two halves relative to one another?

options.text: Mirror finishing is done by diamond turning machine
Dimples are created on the surface

solution:
The correct answer is __Serrations are used.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Serrations__ are used to locate the two halves of the connecting rod relative to one another.
 
• Serrations ensure perfect alignment of the two halves when assembled.
 
• They provide a firm grip and prevent slipping during operation.
 
• Serrations are a cost-effective and efficient solution for this purpose.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mirror finishing:**

 
 
• This process is carried out to achieve a smooth and reflective surface.
 
• It is not used for alignment purposes.
 
 
 
• **Dimples:**
 
 
• Dimples are used for stress distribution but not for alignment.
 
 
 
• **Taper threads:**
 
 
• Taper threads are used for fastening and sealing in applications, not for locating two halves.
